customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be among the best in its category, with reliable performance and quick, expert installation. The product receives positive feedback for its taste, elegant design, and efficient purification capabilities, with one customer noting it works well with high TDS levels. While many customers appreciate the value for money, opinions about service are mixed, with some praising Aquaguard's service while others find it poor.

reviews.author: Kiran
reviews.title: Aquaguard
reviews.body: Product is Good , Installation is done on the given date. Production is functing good for now, it is second day only, water taste is good.

reviews.author: Vijay Agrawal
reviews.title: Reasonably priced product
reviews.body: Amazing machine with a classy look. Technician was very professional. TDS meter provided with the machine is very useful

reviews.author: Harish
reviews.title: Great water purifier with no installation help
reviews.body: Super easy to operate day-to-day and delivers impressive TDS numbers. The only real trade-off is that you can't rely on professional installer support, so you have to handle the setup and maintenance yourself. Overall, highly recommended if you don't mind spend extra for installation to get actual professional help

reviews.author: Nil
reviews.title: Aquaguard Purifier
reviews.body: Been using since last 10 days, the built in TDS display (In/Out) is pretty good and helpful and the purifier can have boaring, tap and well water as well and purify it. Installation was also done quickly.

reviews.author: Harini
reviews.title: Great Product
reviews.body: working very fine for 1300 TDS near sea area. Good product. Installation also smooth
